title: Parse: Extract requirements from Transport Protocol
description:
Read spec section, extract MUST/SHALL/SHOULD statements, create checklist in task description

## Extracted Requirements from spec/07-transport-app.md

### Section 9: Transport Layer

**UDP (Section 9.1):**
- [ ] MUST: Gateways MUST translate mesh-internal ports (5681, 5682, 5685-5687) to standard protocols before forwarding to external networks

**TCP (Section 9.2):**
- [ ] NOT RECOMMENDED: TCP is NOT recommended for LoRa mesh

### Section 10: Application Layer

**SenML (Section 10.1.2):**
- [ ] MAY: SenML Compact Profile MAY use integer keys and implied units while remaining RFC 8428 compliant

**Duty Cycle (Section 10.2.3):**
- [ ] MUST: Nodes MUST track duty cycle usage and throttle transmissions accordingly
- [ ] MUST: Senders receiving 5.03 Service Unavailable MUST back off for the indicated duration

**Fragmentation (Section 10.5):**
- [ ] NOT RECOMMENDED: CoAP Block-wise (RFC 7959) is NOT RECOMMENDED for LICHEN
- [ ] MUST: When receiver reassembly limit is unknown, application chunks MUST fit the mandatory 1281-byte SCHC receiver capacity

### CoAP Parameters (Section 10.2.2)
The spec defines LICHEN-specific CoAP parameters:
- ACK_TIMEOUT: 15s (vs RFC 2s)
- ACK_RANDOM_FACTOR: 2.0 (vs RFC 1.5)
- MAX_RETRANSMIT: 2 (vs RFC 4)
- LEISURE: 15s (vs RFC 5s)
- PROBING_RATE: 0.1 B/s (vs RFC 1 B/s)

### Priority Levels (Section 10.2.3)
TX queue priority ordering (0=highest):
- P0: SOS/emergency
- P1: RPL control (DIO, DAO)
- P2: CoAP CON, tactical chat
- P3: CoAP NON, telemetry, position
- P4: Bulk transfer, firmware
close_reason: Extracted 7 normative requirements from spec/07-transport-app.md: 4 MUST (gateway translation, duty cycle tracking, 5.03 backoff, chunk size limit), 2 NOT RECOMMENDED (TCP, CoAP Block-wise), 1 MAY (SenML compact profile). Also documented CoAP parameter tuning and TX priority levels. Checklist added to description for use by dependent implementation task.
